title: Proper-flat right-adjoint base change on a single affine chart
statement: Let f:X to Y be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, Y and Y prime qcqs, g:Y prime to Y, and X prime=X times_Y Y prime [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], right adjoints a,a prime to the canonical lifted derived direct images, and ordinary base-change witnesses hβ for every object. Assume the affine-case assertion [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-affine-basechange] for all affine base squares with these hypotheses. For K in D_QCoh(Y), affine opens V of Y and W of Y prime with W contained in g inverse(V), restriction of the ambient image of dualityEquationBaseChangeMap(f,g,K) [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map] to f prime inverse(W), using exact schemeOpenRestriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], is invertible. No covering or global isomorphism conclusion is asserted.

proof.text:
1. Let V and W be the given affine opens with W contained in g inverse(V). Set U=f inverse(V) and U prime=f prime inverse(W). The restricted proper-flat finitely presented maps are qcqs. The ordinary derived base-change map on the chart square is the restriction of beta after the canonical direct-image and pullback restriction comparisons, so hβ supplies its invertibility. Restriction also preserves quasi-coherent cohomology.

2. Use proper_flat_rightAdjoint_restriction_open on f and f prime, with their given adjunctions and the canonical open restriction adjunctions, to make the open-unit arrows invertible. In equation (48.4.1.1), the other arrows come from right-adjoint uniqueness and the open counit and are canonical isomorphisms. Thus identify restriction of a(K) with the right adjoint for U to V applied to K restricted to V; do the same for a prime and W.

3. Paste the two open squares horizontally with the original square. The mate construction is compatible with this pasting: the composite units and counits give the pasted mate, by the triangle identities; conjugation of invertible beta commutes with restriction and inversion. Remark 48.6.1 therefore identifies the restricted global map, up to the invertible comparisons of the preceding step, with the canonical mate for U to V and W to V. Apply haffine to that square and K restricted to V. Its mate is invertible, so the restricted global map is invertible. There is no descent or covering step in this assertion.

theorem proper_flat_rightAdjoint_baseChange_chart
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (haffine : ∀ {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y f).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y),
    IsIso (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (W : Y'.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction (pullback f g) ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.map
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι.map
        (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y Y'
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
          f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K)))
